subject: Post-call recap and next steps: GDPR / DPA / SCC & evidence requests (Finova)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hastings <tom.hastings@finova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T09:12:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap and next steps: GDPR / DPA / SCC & evidence requests (Finova)

Hi Tom —

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum for your procurement/security review: 

Summary from today's discovery:
- Finova handles customer payment and PII for EU customers; you are the data controller for the flows we discussed.
- Key security asks: SOC 2 Type II evidence, confirmation of processor controls (encryption, access logs, incident process), and a DPA with EU SCCs for controller->processor flows.
- You shared a vendor security questionnaire during the call and asked for an estimated timeline for SOC 2 evidence + DPA draft.

Proposed next steps:
1) Please send the vendor security questionnaire (VSA) you mentioned — we can start filling sections immediately.
2) I'll loop in our Security (Olga) and Legal (Karthik) for SOC 2 and DPA/SCC questions.
3) Legal will propose the DPA + recommended SCC module (controller-to-processor) and a short SDET (security evidence) packet.
4) We aim to return the VSA + SOC 2 report and a draft DPA within 5 business days. If you need faster, let us know which sections are highest priority.

Attachments: none from my side yet — please upload the VSA to the Drive link below or attach in reply.

Drive link (we'll also share from our side): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-finova-security-evidence

Thanks again — happy to hop on a short follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T10:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Post-call recap and next steps: GDPR / DPA / SCC & evidence requests (Finova)

Marissa / Ben —

Thanks for the ping and the summary. Bottom-line checklist from Security for SOC 2 / DPA intake so Legal can draft the right document: 

Immediate items we need to collect from Finova: 
- Completed Vendor Security Questionnaire (VSA) — ask them to mark critical assets and data categories.
- Confirmation of data roles: you indicated Finova is controller; please have the customer confirm in writing (email is fine).
- Any special categories of data (health, biometric, etc.) or regulated datasets (HIPAA) — call these out.

What we'll provide from Redwood: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) — we'll attach a redacted report and provide an option for an NDA if they need the full report.
- List of subprocessors and subprocessors' locations — include links to our subprocessors registry.
- Short evidence pack: encryption at rest + in transit description, key management, access logging retention, incident response summary, and retention/deletion processes.

SCC module preference note: for controller->processor relationships we generally recommend the EU Commission standard clauses (controller-to-processor variant). Legal should include the processor annex and option to add additional data flow/mapping exhibit.

Timeline: if we get the VSA today, Security + Legal can triage and return SOC2 + DPA draft within 3-5 business days. If Finova needs a faster turnaround for specific questions, call out the top 5 priority items in the VSA.

I'll prepare the redacted SOC 2 and the evidence summary and upload to the shared Drive once I have the VSA.

— Olga
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

From: Tom Hastings <tom.hastings@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T10:40:00Z
Subject: RE: Post-call recap and next steps: GDPR / DPA / SCC & evidence requests (Finova)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming: Finova is the data controller for our customers; we expect Redwood to act as a processor for hosted inference in your hosted API. We do not have regulated health data in scope for this initial integration.

I've attached the vendor security questionnaire (VSA) we use — please have your security team complete sections A (general security), B (encryption & keys), and H (subprocessors).

Requests and timelines: 
- We need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a DPA + SCCs by next Friday (2027-08-21). If you can't meet full SOC 2 by then, provide the redacted report and the evidence pack Olga mentioned.
- For the SCCs, we prefer the controller-to-processor module (controller-to-processor standard clauses). If Redwood has a preferred processor addendum, send that and we'll circle back with redlines.

Attachments: VendorSecurityQuestionnaire-Finova.xlsx (attached)

Tom Hastings
Head of Infrastructure & Security Ops | Finova
thastings@finova.com

Subject: RE: Post-call recap and next steps: GDPR / DPA / SCC & evidence requests (Finova)

Tom —

Appreciate the quick confirmation and the VSA. We can meet the timeline to return a redacted SOC 2 and a draft DPA + SCC module by EOD next Friday (2027-08-21). Action items below: 

From Finova (you):
- Please confirm any retention requirements (default 90 days for logs, but call out if you need different).
- If there are any specific subprocessors you object to, flag them in the VSA.

From Redwood (we'll action):
- Security (Olga) will upload a redacted SOC 2 Type II and the evidence pack to the Drive link.
- Legal (Karthik) will prepare a DPA with the controller-to-processor SCC module included and a short exhibit showing data categories and processing purposes.
- I'll complete the VSA sections you requested and return the partially completed file within 24 hours.

Attachments we'll upload: SOC2-Type2-Redwood-2026.pdf (redacted), Redwood-DPA-draft-processor-addendum.docx

If it helps the Finova team, we can schedule a 30-minute deep-dive on Wednesday to walk through any VSA sections or specific SCC language.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
